Let's create a Meme Generator using React + Vite, similar to your Chef Claude project.

Step 1 — Create a Vite React project

Open VS Code and launch the terminal.

Run:

Bash

Next, navigate into your project:

Bash

cd meme-generator

Install dependencies:

Bash

npm install

Start the development server:

Bash

npm run dev

Open the localhost URL shown in your terminal, usually http://localhost:5173.

Step 2 — Project folder structure

Plain text
meme-generator/ │ ├── public/ │ ├── src/ │ ├── components/ │ │ ├── Header.jsx │ │ └── Meme.jsx │ │ │ ├── App.jsx │ ├── App.css │ ├── index.css │ └── main.jsx │ ├── index.html ├── package.json └── vite.config.js

Step 3 — Create Header.jsx

Inside src, create a folder named components, then create Header.jsx.

JavaScript

export default function Header() {
    return (
        <header className="header">
            <span className="header-logo">😎</span>
            <h1>Meme Generator</h1>
            <span className="header-project">React + Vite</span>
        </header>
    );
}

Step 4 — Create Meme.jsx

This component fetches meme images from the Imgflip API and lets users add text.

JavaScript

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";

export default function Meme() {

    const [meme, setMeme] = useState({
        topText: "",
        bottomText: "",
        imageUrl: ""
    });

    const [allMemes, setAllMemes] = useState([]);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [error, setError] = useState("");

    useEffect(() => {

        async function loadMemes() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch(
                    "https://api.imgflip.com/get_memes"
                );

                if (!response.ok) {
                    throw new Error("Failed to load memes");
                }

                const data = await response.json();

                if (!data.success || !data.data?.memes?.length) {
                    throw new Error("No memes available");
                }

                setAllMemes(data.data.memes);

                setMeme(prev => ({
                    ...prev,
                    imageUrl: data.data.memes[0].url
                }));

            } catch (err) {
                setError(err.message);
            } finally {
                setLoading(false);
            }
        }

        loadMemes();

    }, []);

    function getMemeImage() {

        if (!allMemes.length) return;

        const randomIndex = Math.floor(
            Math.random() * allMemes.length
        );

        setMeme(prev => ({
            ...prev,
            imageUrl: allMemes[randomIndex].url
        }));
    }

    function handleChange(event) {

        const { name, value } = event.target;

        setMeme(prev => ({
            ...prev,
            [name]: value
        }));
    }

    return (
        <main className="main">

            <div className="form">

                <div className="form-field">
                    <label htmlFor="topText">Top Text</label>

                    <input
                        type="text"
                        id="topText"
                        name="topText"
                        placeholder="Enter top text"
                        value={meme.topText}
                        onChange={handleChange}
                    />
                </div>

                <div className="form-field">
                    <label htmlFor="bottomText">Bottom Text</label>

                    <input
                        type="text"
                        id="bottomText"
                        name="bottomText"
                        placeholder="Enter bottom text"
                        value={meme.bottomText}
                        onChange={handleChange}
                    />
                </div>

            </div>

            <button
                className="generate-btn"
                onClick={getMemeImage}
                disabled={loading || allMemes.length === 0}
            >
                Get a new meme image
            </button>

            {loading && <p>Loading memes...</p>}

            {error && (
                <p role="alert" className="error">
                    {error}
                </p>
            )}

            {meme.imageUrl && (
                <div className="meme">

                    <img
                        src={meme.imageUrl}
                        alt="Selected meme template"
                    />

                    <span className="top">
                        {meme.topText}
                    </span>

                    <span className="bottom">
                        {meme.bottomText}
                    </span>

                </div>
            )}

        </main>
    );
}

Replace your src/App.css with:

CSS

.header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 15px;
    padding: 22px 40px;

    font-size: 34px;
}

    margin-left: auto;
    font-size: 13px;
}

    max-width: 750px;
    margin: 45px auto;

}

    display: grid;

}

.form-field {

    gap: 8px;

    font-weight: 600;

    border-radius: 6px;

}

.generate-btn {
    width: 100%;
    margin: 20px 0 30px;
    padding: 15px;

    border-radius: 6px;

    color: white;
    font-size: 16px;

    cursor: pointer;
}

.generate-btn:disabled {
    opacity: 0.6;
    cursor: not-allowed;
}

.meme {

    width: fit-content;
    max-width: 100%;
    margin: auto;
}

    border-radius: 6px;

    text-shadow: 2px 2px 3px black;
}

.meme .top {
    top: 10px;
}

.meme .bottom {
    bottom: 10px;
}

.error {
    color: #b42318;
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
    .header {
        padding: 18px;
